# Somaliland Weddings & Events

> The premier verified wedding marketplace, event operating platform, and market intelligence suite in the Republic of Somaliland.
> Built & Engineered by M2 Creative & Consulting (Hargeisa, Republic of Somaliland).

## Overview
- Organization: M2 Creative & Consulting (https://m2creative.site/)
- Lead Creator: Mahmoud Mohamed Awaleh (https://m2awaleh.vercel.app/)
- Primary Launch Market: Hargeisa, Republic of Somaliland
- Regional Service Coverage: Hargeisa, Borama (Awdal), Berbera (Sahil Coast), Burao (Togdheer)
- Dual Stacks: Next.js 14 App Router + Hostinger Standalone PHP 8.2+ & MySQL

## Key Public Routes
- Homepage: https://weddings.m2creative.sl/
- Provider Directory: https://weddings.m2creative.sl/providers
- Service Packages: https://weddings.m2creative.sl/packages
- Package Comparison Matrix: https://weddings.m2creative.sl/compare
- Event Planning Workspace & Budget Calculator: https://weddings.m2creative.sl/plan
- Public Expos & Bridal Showcases: https://weddings.m2creative.sl/events
- Resource Library & Verified Contracts: https://weddings.m2creative.sl/resources
- Market Intelligence & Economic Research: https://weddings.m2creative.sl/market-insights

- XML Sitemap: https://weddings.m2creative.sl/sitemap.xml
